name: Artificer
description: A magical inventor who channels spells through tools and creates temporary magic items, bolstering allies with clever Intelligence-based tricks.
armor: Light and Medium armor and Shields
tools: Thieves' Tools, Tinker's Tools, and one type of Artisan's Tools of your choice

spellcasting.focus: Thieves' Tools, Tinker's Tools, or other Artisan's Tools

features.name: Spellcasting
features.text: You cast Artificer spells using Intelligence, with Thieves' Tools, Tinker's Tools or other proficient Artisan's Tools as your focus. You know 2 cantrips (more at levels 10 and 14), prepare level 1+ spells from the Artificer list (number per the class table), and can swap cantrips and prepared spells after a Long Rest.

features.name: Tinker's Magic
features.text: You know Mending. As a Magic action with Tinker's Tools you create one simple mundane item (e.g. rope, caltrops, lamp, sack, crowbar) within 5 feet; it lasts until your next Long Rest. Uses equal your Intelligence modifier (min 1) per Long Rest.

features.name: Replicate Magic Item
features.text: You learn 4 magic item plans (more at levels 6, 10, 14, 18) and can swap one each time you gain a level. After a Long Rest with Tinker's Tools in hand you create up to 2 magic items from different plans (3 at level 6, 4 at 10, 5 at 14, 6 at 18). Items vanish 1d4 days after you die, can be attuned to instantly on creation, and wands or weapons made this way can serve as your spellcasting focus.

features.name: Artificer Subclass
features.text: Choose an Artificer subclass; you gain its features at levels 3, 5, 9 and 15.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.text: Gain the Ability Score Improvement feat or another feat you qualify for. Repeats at levels 8, 12 and 16.

features.name: Subclass Feature
features.text: You gain a feature from your Artificer subclass.

features.name: Magic Item Tinker
features.text: Adds three options to Replicate Magic Item. Charge: as a Bonus Action spend a spell slot to restore charges equal to its level to a charged item you made. Drain: as a Bonus Action destroy an item you made to gain a temporary spell slot (level 1 for Common, level 2 for Uncommon/Rare), once per Long Rest. Transmute: as a Magic action turn one of your items into another item from a plan you know, once per Long Rest.

features.name: Flash of Genius
features.text: As a Reaction when you or a creature you see within 30 feet fails an ability check or saving throw, add your Intelligence modifier (min +1) to the roll. Uses equal your Intelligence modifier (min 1) per Long Rest.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.text: Gain the Ability Score Improvement feat or another feat you qualify for.

features.name: Subclass Feature
features.text: You gain a feature from your Artificer subclass.

features.name: Magic Item Adept
features.text: You can attune to up to 4 magic items at once. You also learn a third cantrip.

features.name: Spell-Storing Item
features.text: After a Long Rest you can store a level 1-3 Artificer spell (casting time of an action, no consumed material component) in a weapon or spellcasting focus you touch. A creature holding it can use a Magic action to cast it with your spellcasting modifier, once per turn, for a total of twice your Intelligence modifier (min 2) uses.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.text: Gain the Ability Score Improvement feat or another feat you qualify for.

features.name: Advanced Artifice
features.text: You can attune to up to 5 magic items. You also learn a fourth cantrip. When you finish a Short Rest you regain one expended use of Flash of Genius (Refreshed Genius).

features.name: Subclass Feature
features.text: You gain a feature from your Artificer subclass.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.text: Gain the Ability Score Improvement feat or another feat you qualify for.

features.name: Magic Item Master
features.text: You can attune to up to 6 magic items at once.

features.name: Epic Boon
features.text: Gain an Epic Boon feat or another feat you qualify for. Boon of Energy Resistance is suggested.

features.name: Soul of Artifice
features.text: Cheat Death: when you drop to 0 HP without dying, you can destroy any number of Uncommon or Rare items from Replicate Magic Item to instead have 20 HP per item destroyed. Magical Guidance: a Short Rest restores all Flash of Genius uses if you are attuned to at least one magic item.

multiclass.gains: Tinker's Tools, one skill from the Artificer list, Light and Medium armor, Shields
